integrity: The analytic proof establishes the quantified result. The bundled finite computations are supplementary checks and are not treated as proof of the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional, diagonalizable matrices with simple real spectrum and positive-definite metrics only. Historical novelty risk remains from older Riesz-basis and matrix-scaling literature; no infinite-dimensional extension is claimed.
title: Best-conditioned quasi-Hermitian metrics reduce to diagonal Gram scaling
